description: Example enterprise support SLA targets. Targets are measured in calendar time to keep the lab simple; a real policy usually also defines business hours per customer tier.

P1.label: Critical - production down or fraud decisions failing

P2.label: High - major feature degraded, workaround is painful

P3.label: Normal - question or partial issue with a workaround

P4.label: Low - how-to, feature request, or cosmetic
